component.name: vdpi Desktop
component.summary: Self-healing local anti-DPI and encrypted DNS engine

description.p: vdpi Desktop is a lightweight native desktop application built in Rust for the vdpi anti-DPI engine. It runs 100% locally on your device with zero remote servers, zero telemetry, and zero third-party relays.

ul.li: 7-stage adaptive TLS ClientHello desynchronization with persistent per-host stage caching
Built-in encrypted DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) resolver with Cloudflare, Quad9, AdGuard, Google, and custom URL presets
Local HTTP/HTTPS/SOCKS5/UDP proxy and per-app split tunneling controls
Live throughput telemetry, connection diagnostics, and system tray integration
Full English and Turkish localization with calibrated light and dark themes

screenshot.caption: Overview dashboard with live throughput and protection controls
Visual per-app split tunneling with quick presets

description.p: Refreshed desktop interface with live service controls, split tunneling quick presets, DNS-over-HTTPS presets, and full English/Turkish localization.
